description: Run hookcheck, actionpin, injectcheck, mcpvet, depguard, and flowcheck against a local repo path and store the results as a timestamped scan record with stable finding IDs. Returns the scan record and every finding observation. Use this to start or refresh tracking for a repo.

name.description: Repo key to file the scan under (default: GitHub slug from the git remote, else the directory name)

path.description: Local path of the repo or directory to scan

tools.description: Subset of tools to run (default: all six)

name: ingest_scan
